architecture_principles: the unit of decision is an experiment, not a formulation
value of information is computed by a deterministic scientific tool, not by an additional language model
every registered hypothesis carries an explicit pre-result prediction rule and an explicit falsification condition
a measurement that cannot separate any registered hypothesis scores zero discrimination, and that is a scientific result rather than a defect
weight sensitivity is reported as decision stability, never as model confidence
ties in the deterministic layer are reported as ties; the tool must not manufacture a preference it does not have
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
the mechanism question and the Agent framework are separate contributions and are reported separately

candidate_space.rationale: V4 deliberately reuses the byte-identical V3 lattice. Continuous-space optimization and any new wet-lab work are out of scope, so that the measured change between V3 and V4 is the decision object and the VOI layer, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> evidence/tool layer (including the deterministic VOI tool) -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze
architecture.claim_boundary: V4.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime. Its adjudication tests whether a registered hypothesis survives contact with the completed measurement. It is not a contemporaneous pre-experimental record and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_VOI_GUIDED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V4
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
turning the study into a pure AI benchmark
weakening or replacing the rheological mechanism result
architecture.purpose: Outcome-blind scientific decision Agent that selects the next formulation x measurement EXPERIMENT by transparent value of information, rather than selecting a formulation candidate alone.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question that the next experiment must answer, then request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations

execute read-only scientific tools, including the paper-derived state-aware rheology tool, external evidence retrieval, and the deterministic VOI tool that scores every formulation x measurement experiment card
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value, stating the hypotheses it separates and what each possible outcome would establish
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability of the primary observable, and whether the stated falsification criterion can actually be met by the measurement
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported VOI weight sensitivity and the skeptic's strongest objection
commit to one experiment card, or abstain, and state the acceptance and falsification criteria that will adjudicate it
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card with timestamps, model identifiers and cryptographic hashes of every input

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V4 is an independent architecture. configs/agent_v3.json, prompts/agent_v3_*.txt, src/pur_new/agent_v3.py and every frozen V3 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V4.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards
voi_tool.not_a_posterior: The local design contains six audited realizations and two thermal-hold trajectories. That does not support a calibrated Bayesian expected-information computation, so no posterior probability is fabricated. Weight sensitivity is reported instead.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Accept the E2 reactive-core baseline as consistent with H-CORE if the mean SI_15_60 across at least two independent repeats is between 7.51% and 11.51%, inclusive, corresponding to agreement within ±2.00 percentage points of the 9.51% linear-dilution reference.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: Falsify H-CORE if the mean SI_15_60 is below 7.51% or above 11.51%, because it then differs from the 9.51% prediction by more than the declared 2.00 percentage-point resolution. This experiment cannot falsify H-RESIN or H-DUAL because both modifier axes are zero and therefore those hypotheses remain observationally entangled with H-CORE in this formulation.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run state-recorded, matched-window 120 C holds on the E2 core, an acrylic-only composition, and an acrylic-plus-minor-tackifier composition at matched reactive mass fraction, using at least two independent preparations per composition and an in-range viscosity state anchor.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Mean SI_15_60 = 100 × (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15, reported as percent across at least two independent preparations at 120 C.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C02 is scientifically defensible as the central unmodified E2 reference for the observed 120 C viscosity-growth failure. The direct hold observable is interpretable and non-extrapolative, while the acceptance criterion is corrected to the registry's ±2.00 percentage-point agreement requirement rather than the weaker 9.51% threshold. Its limitation is explicit: modifier hypotheses remain untested.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the robustness adjudicator and proposer in selecting S1C02 with M-HOLD-120 because it directly measures the unresolved thermal-hold failure coordinate at the representative E2 core anchor. I followed the skeptic in narrowing the claim: this is a committed reactive-core baseline, not a discriminator of H-RESIN or H-DUAL, and its interpretation is limited by uncontrolled realization state.

planner.failure_mode: Viscosity growth during prolonged 120 C melt residence, with the contribution of reactive-core dilution versus modifier-specific stabilization unresolved
planner.failure_mode_evidence: The original 120 C thermal-hold measurements show a 15-to-60 min relative viscosity change of 9.51% for E1 and 51.54% for E5; no matched hold trajectory is measured for E2 or the modifier-axis candidates.
planner.least_resolved_justification: Only E1 and E5 have measured 120 C hold trajectories, each from a single run with four time points over 15-90 min, while E2 and the modifier-axis design space have no hold measurements. Thus the time-dependent failure coordinate and its dependence on acrylic-like versus tackifier-like modification are much less resolved than the temperature response, which has six-point sweeps across multiple runs, or the realized viscosity level, for which E2 has three-run spread data.
measurement_requirements: Measure viscosity at 120 C at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min and report the matched-window SI_15_60 relative change.
Use at least two independent preparation repeats for every compared composition.
Include a reactive-core reference and compositionally matched acrylic-only and acrylic-plus-tackifier conditions so linear dilution, superlinear suppression, and tackifier dependence are separable.
Record the preparation and thermal-history state and measure an anchor viscosity or equivalent state coordinate so drift comparisons are not confounded by uncontrolled realization differences.
Keep the comparison within the measured temperature and 15-60 min time windows without extrapolation.
planner.scientific_question: At a matched reactive mass fraction and matched process state, does modifier addition suppress 120 C viscosity drift substantially below the linear-dilution prediction (separating H-RESIN from H-CORE), and is the low-drift regime reached by an acrylic-like modifier alone or only when the minor tackifier-like axis is also nonzero (separating H-DUAL)?

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: A drift below 4.75% would falsify the linear-dilution prediction for the unmodified E2 core and indicate unexpectedly strong core stabilization. It would not, by itself, establish H-RESIN or H-DUAL because no modifier axis is active.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: A drift at or above 9.51% would support H-CORE at the E2 reference composition and would leave H-RESIN and H-DUAL untested rather than falsified.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result between 4.75% and 9.51% would be insufficient to separate the registered hypotheses at the stated 2% resolution and would establish only that the E2 core lies between the low-drift and linear-reference bounds.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It is an already characterized reactive-core endpoint rather than the central E2 anchor, so it adds less representative baseline information.
It is another stoichiometrically displaced core-only point and does not activate either modifier axis or separate any registered hypothesis pair.
It perturbs reactive-core composition without testing the acrylic-like or tackifier-like intervention regions and therefore cannot address the scientific question.
It is a further core-composition perturbation with no modifier axis, so its hold result remains non-discriminating for H-RESIN and H-DUAL.

proposer.reasoning: Among the supplied tied cards, S1C02 is the most scientifically representative direct hold baseline because it is the E2 centre-point reactive core. The experiment directly measures the unresolved isothermal time coordinate without extrapolation or model fitting, but its zero-modifier composition cannot separate the modifier hypotheses; a matched acrylic-only and acrylic-plus-tackifier hold experiment would be required for that adjudication.
proposer.tie_break_justification: S1C02 is the E2 reactive-core anchor at the geometric centre of the characterized local design. It is preferable to the other tied core-only cards because it provides the most representative baseline for interpreting later modifier experiments, while using the direct, non-model-fit hold observable and the matched 120 C, 15-60 min window.

residual_decision_risk: The experiment cannot separate H-CORE, H-RESIN, or H-DUAL because both modifier axes are zero.
At least two repeats without full process-state control may not distinguish formulation effects from realization-state variation.
The criterion that drift at or above 9.51% supports H-CORE is broader than the registry requirement of agreement with the linear-dilution prediction within measurement resolution.
A subsequent matched panel containing E2, acrylic-only, acrylic-plus-tackifier, and preferably tackifier-only conditions is still required for mechanism discrimination.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection is valid: S1C02 has no acrylic-like or minor-tackifier-like modifier, so H-CORE, H-RESIN, and H-DUAL make the same prediction and the hold cannot adjudicate modifier mechanisms. However, the proposer explicitly presents S1C02 as an E2 reactive-core baseline and correctly states that it does not establish H-RESIN or H-DUAL. Therefore the objection limits the conclusions and requires subsequent matched modifier-active holds, but it does not invalidate this baseline experiment's stated purpose. The lack of process-state control remains a substantial interpretive risk.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: S1C02::M-HOLD-120 is in the tied deterministic top set with S1C01::M-HOLD-120 through S1C09::M-HOLD-120. The supplied payload does not provide top_experiment_set_stability, base_margin_to_first_strictly_lower, or recommendation_flip_boundary values, so no specific defensible perturbation boundary can be identified. Under the stated minimality-first rule, the proposal remains top ranked; a weighting that gives greater priority to intervention sufficiency or hypothesis discrimination would defensibly favor matched modifier-active holds, but no such candidate card is supplied.

skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The numerical threshold below 4.75% is larger than the declared 2.00% resolution gap from the 9.51% reference and is directly measurable in the 15-60 min window. However, the full stated falsification logic is not attainable as a reliable hypothesis test: H-RESIN is not testable without an active resin modifier, H-CORE requires agreement within resolution rather than merely drift at or above 9.51%, and the protocol lacks process-state control despite the E2 120 C realization spread of 3.57x and a process-state risk score of 0.75.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A result from S1C02 can support or challenge only the E2 reactive-core baseline; it cannot support H-RESIN, falsify H-RESIN, or adjudicate H-DUAL.
objections.objection: The selected composition S1C02 has AC1920 = 0.0% and TK100 = 0.0%, with reactive mass fraction 1.0000. Consequently, H-RESIN and H-DUAL make the same prediction as H-CORE (all are listed as 9.51% in hypothesis_discrimination_detail), so the experiment cannot separate any registered hypothesis pair. It does not test whether resin modification causes superlinear suppression or whether the minor tackifier axis is required.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Any interpretation of the S1C02 hold as evidence about modifier mechanisms would be unsupported; the experiment is a baseline measurement, not a mechanism-discriminating intervention.
objections.objection: There is no simultaneous-axis confounding because both modifier axes are fixed at zero, but this is a stronger limitation: the intervention does not move either registered modifier axis. Therefore, attribution to acrylic-like dilution, tackifier-specific drift suppression, or axis specialization is unavailable rather than merely confounded.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: This is not a material weakness for the direct drift measurement; the main limitations arise from hypothesis coverage and state control, not observable definition.
objections.objection: The primary observable SI_15_60 is directly computed from viscosity at 15 and 60 min within the specified 120 C hold. It requires no model fit, extrapolation, or imputation, and the 15-60 min window is within the measured reference window.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A result below 4.75% may challenge the core baseline, but a result at or above 9.51% cannot reliably establish stoichiometry-only behavior under this state- uncontrolled protocol, and neither result adjudicates the resin hypotheses.
objections.objection: The stated criterion that drift at or above 9.51% would support H-CORE is broader than the registry criterion, which requires agreement with the linear-dilution prediction within measurement resolution. In addition, the protocol specifies only at least two repeats and does not control process state, while the E2 repeatability data show a 2.80-3.57x spread in realized viscosity at 120 C and the candidate has process_state_risk_detail score 0.75 with six missing process fields. Thus the protocol does not establish that a measured drift difference can be attributed to formulation rather than realization state. The separate statement that drift at or above 9.51% falsifies H-RESIN is not a meaningful test of H-RESIN because no resin-modified composition is present.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: No leakage-related claim is unsupported on the supplied record.
objections.objection: No outcome-derived formulation identity, wet-lab result, or post-result label is used in the proposer reasoning. The proposal also stays within the registry's formulation-level rheological scope and does not claim a molecularly resolved reaction pathway.

skeptic.recommended_change: Replace the single core-only hold with matched 120 C, 15-60 min holds for at least four conditions: the E2 reactive-core reference, an acrylic-only composition, an acrylic-plus-tackifier composition, and preferably a tackifier-only condition. Preserve matched reactive mass fraction, recalculate stoichiometry if modifiers are reactive, use at least two independent preparations per condition, record the six missing process-state fields, and include a state anchor so drift differences are not attributed to chemistry when realization state differs.
skeptic.strongest_objection: S1C02 activates neither modifier axis: AC1920 = 0.0% and TK100 = 0.0%. All three registered hypotheses therefore predict the same 9.51% drift, so the experiment cannot deliver the claimed discrimination and cannot test H-RESIN or H-DUAL.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The phosphoric-acid-labelled E1 +P curve is not used in the chemistry-audited primary state model.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.

provenance_audit.reason: The source record is phosphoric-acid-labelled and its additive identity/amount is not represented in formulations.csv; it is retained as sensitivity-only until chemistry is reconciled.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

top_cards_in_policy_order.acceptance_criterion: Matched 15-60 min drift at 120 C stays below 4.75% across at least two repeats, i.e. below half the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51% implied by a reactive mass fraction of 1.0000. This accepts H-RESIN over H-CORE.
top_cards_in_policy_order.falsification_criterion: H-RESIN is falsified if matched 15-60 min drift is at or above the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51%. H-CORE is falsified if drift falls below 4.75%, a separation larger than the 2.00% resolution threshold. H-DUAL is falsified if this acrylic-only composition reaches the low-drift regime with no minor tackifier present.
